roadmapLane: P2: original-request custody and explicit recovery lifecycle

implementation.behavior: Remember validated original and intent observations as owner-local key/checksum witnesses. Later disappearance or changed checksums latch CUSTODY_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN instead of returning fresh absence or a replacement record.
implementation.sourcesOfKnowledge: Successful original/intent readback before dispatch and fully validated recovery reads. A started retention attempt also prevents a later missing original from becoming unobserved absence.
implementation.bound: At most custodyPolicy.maxRequests selected-grant keys, in the existing explicit 1..1024 capacity range. Each private entry contains the two key strings and the original checksum plus optional intent checksum; no full body, proof, payment payload or response is cached.
implementation.unchanged: Exported surfaces, projected data shape, normal action counters, borrowed-store ownership and cached close Promise behavior remain unchanged in the selected scenarios.
implementation.uncertainty: Restoring the original intent after a detected loss does not clear the latched custody flag. Later submissions remain refused without another store call or callback.
implementation.absence: An unobserved missing key may still return null. A retained original for which no intent has been observed may still return NO_INTENT_RECORDED; neither output authorizes dispatch.
implementation.limits: Witnesses are private to one owner, are not restored by a new owner, do not repair lost data and are not durable/authenticated receipts. Secure memory erasure is not promised.

sourceBinding.earlierCoverage: Earlier owner and downstream native SQLite/fresh-process records pin the preceding owner source. Their artifacts and guards remain unchanged; their counts are not combined or rebound to this source.

runtime.digestReuse: Whole runtime digests reused only after all nine physical identity fields matched; no large binary rehash.

launch.environment: env -i with one synthetic opt-in and four exact source pins

execution.actualComponents: Current V2/V3 JavaScript owners and original/intent custody contracts are executed.
execution.declaredComponents: Trusted synchronous stores, funding projections and callbacks are synthetic in-memory fixture data. Map deletion/replacement is an injected declared-store inconsistency, not actual SQLite corruption or a filesystem experiment.

coverage.submittedOriginalLoss: A V2 original confirmed during submission later disappears. readOriginal fails closed, and a subsequent submit makes no store call or callback.
coverage.submittedIntentLoss: A V3 intent confirmed before a completed callback disappears. Recovery refuses it; reading the still-valid original or restoring the old intent does not clear custody uncertainty.
coverage.observedOriginalLoss: A V2 original first learned through a recovery read later disappears. Recovery does not return null.
coverage.observedIntentChange: A previously observed V3 intent is replaced by a different valid-checksum intent for the same original. Existing envelope validation passes, but the local witness detects the change.
coverage.observedOriginalChange: A previously observed V3 original is replaced by a different valid original and matching intent. The prior original checksum still detects the change.
coverage.legitimateAbsence: Previously unobserved absence and an original with no observed intent remain redacted data with authority NONE and no inferred service outcome.
coverage.capacity: An inconsistent declared store supplies a third distinct original under maxRequests=2. The third observation refuses instead of growing the witness set beyond policy; no retain, fence or callback occurs.
coverage.normalLifecycle: Two normal V3 original/intent submissions and repeated recovery/original reads preserve exact serialized envelopes, declared funding bytes, the existing six action/readback counters and a drained cached close.

storage.scratchOutcome: CLEANED: only this task's registered empty scratch/stream directories were removed after all captured streams were retained.

retainedEvidence.exclusionMeaning: Only the intentionally changed owner module is excluded from the prior unchanged-source prefix. Its old pin remains in immutable earlier manifests; every other retained file remains byte/identity bound.
retainedEvidence.preservation: Reuse the immutable 138-source/109-private prefix parts, exclude that one owned source, and bind six source plus 51 private delta pins to complete-cohort seals.
